capabilities.label: Positioning
capabilities.detail: Camunda 8 universal + agentic process orchestration, developer-centric, built on open ISO standards (BPMN, DMN), vendor-independent
features: built on open ISO standards (BPMN, DMN)

capabilities.label: Process modeling (BPMN)
capabilities.detail: BPMN 2.0, Web Modeler (collaborative), Desktop Modeler, business↔IT collaboration, versioning, ad-hoc sub-processes (for AI agents), Copilot, connector templates

capabilities.label: Decision modeling (DMN)
capabilities.detail: DMN engine, decision tables, Decision Requirements Diagrams, FEEL expressions, Business Knowledge Models, History Service, decision-table unit testing

capabilities.label: Workflow engine (Zeebe)
capabilities.detail: cloud-native distributed, horizontal scalability, event-streaming/message architecture, HA & resilience, message correlation, timers, instance modification/migration, hot backups, gRPC + REST

capabilities.label: Human tasks (Tasklist)
capabilities.detail: single workspace, task queue with claim/auto-assign, reassignment, pre-populated forms, runtime-editable properties, SLA-adherence visibility, escalations, case history

capabilities.label: Operations (Operate)
capabilities.detail: live instance monitoring, incident detection/resolution, immutable audit trails, logging

capabilities.label: Process analytics (Optimize)
capabilities.detail: KPI dashboards, branch analysis, heatmaps, outlier/bottleneck ID, BPMN/DMN execution viz, target-value monitoring, predictive analytics, ML-ready datasets, ProcessOS

capabilities.label: Integration/connectors
capabilities.detail: 500+ connectors (Salesforce/SAP/Oracle/Workday/ServiceNow/Slack/Teams/AWS/Azure/GCP), outbound + inbound/webhook + protocol (REST/GraphQL/SOAP/gRPC/AMQP/Kafka), Connector SDK, Marketplace

capabilities.label: RPA
capabilities.detail: Camunda RPA (Robot Framework subset), bot orchestration as process steps with audit trails
features: bot orchestration as process steps with audit trails

capabilities.label: AI / agentic orchestration
capabilities.detail: governed agentic orchestration, AI reasoning native in BPMN, ad-hoc sub-processes for autonomous execution, deterministic + agentic + dynamic models, LLM-agnostic (GPT-4/Gemini/Claude), AI connectors (OpenAI/Bedrock/Hugging Face), MCP + A2A, human-in-the-loop, tool allow/deny lists

capabilities.label: Developer/API
capabilities.detail: custom job workers (Java/Go/Python/Node/C#/Ruby), Zeebe REST + gRPC, OpenAPI, embedded Java engine, SDKs, OAuth 2.0

capabilities.label: Admin/identity
capabilities.detail: Identity (RBAC/SSO/SAML/OIDC/SCIM), packaged Keycloak, Console cluster management, compensation/error handling
